This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To:
A. Issue Writ Of Certiorari Quashing Impugned
Endorsement Dated 25.03.2022 Vide Annexure-F
Bearing No.Kamdaya/Bhuswa/Samanya/25/2010-11
Issued Respondent No.3.
B. Issue Writ Or Order In The Nature Of Mandamus
Directing The Respondents To Consider The
Representation Of Petitioner Dated 15.03.2022 Vide
Annexure-E And To Pass Additional Award In So Far
As Petitioner Is Concerned For The Left Out Fruit
Bearing Trees As Per Jmc Report.

This Petition, Coming On For Final Hearing, This
Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

In this writ petition, petitioner seeks for the following reliefs:
(a) Issue writ of certiorari quashing impugned endorsement dated 25.03.2022 vide Annexure-F bearing No.KamDaYa/BhuSwa/Samanya/25 /2010-11 issued respondent no.3.

(b) Issue writ or order in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to consider the representation of petitioner dated 15.03.2022 vide Annexure-E and to pass additional award in so far as petitioner is concerned for the left out fruit bearing trees as per JMC report.

(c) Issue such other orders or directions as this Hon'ble court deems fit in the interest of justice and equity.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for the respondents.
Perused the material on record.

sentences.text:
3. The material on record discloses that, pursuant to the Preliminary Notification dated 15.03.2012,
JMC report was submitted on 05.10.2012, which indicated that, there were various trees as detailed hereunder:

As per JMC there were:
1434 Pomegranate (Dalambi) 60 Coconut trees 18 Mango trees 5 Sapota trees 5 Tamarind trees 10 Lemon trees 5 Amala trees 2 Bari tree 2 Gavava 3 Black Plum trees and 30 Mosambi trees 4.
Subsequently, a final notification having been issued on 17.10.2013, an award dated 28.09.2015 was passed.

As per the said award, compensation only in relation to the following trees and not all the trees as per the JMC report were passed by the respondents:
Award passed only to:
117 Pomegranate (Dalambi) 49 Coconut trees 4 Mango trees 14 Lemon trees 12 custard apple 10 sapota tree 5.

Aggrieved by the aforesaid award dated 28.09.2015, the petitioner has preferred a Reference under Section 64(1) and 64(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and the same is pending before the Reference Court.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. It is the grievance of the petitioner that, apart from the fact that the compensation awarded under the award was inadequate and meager insofar as the lands themselves were concerned, the award which is now referred to the Reference Court for re-determination/enhancement also does not grant any compensation in relation to all the trees in terms of the JMC report.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, due to oversight and inadvertence, in the Reference before the Reference Court, the quantification of compensation awarded under the award was challenged only in relation to the lands and not in relation to the trees, which were not included in the award.

It is submitted that the petitioner would make necessary application for amendment of the grounds so as to insert the ground in relation to non-grant of compensation in respect of the trees as per the JMC report.

It is further contended that, since the compensation in respect of all the trees covered under the JMC report was not included in the award, petitioner submitted a representation dated 15.03.2022 in this regard and since the same having been rejected by the respondents vide impugned endorsement dated 25.03.2022 vide Annexure-F, petitioner is before this Court by way of the present petition.
8.
Per contra, learned HCGP for the respondent would support the impugned endorsement and submits that, there is no merit in the petition and the same is liable to be dismissed.

sentences.text: 9. A perusal of the award dated 28.09.2015, would indicate that, all the trees covered under the JMC report have not been included in the award.

The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that, the petitioner would suitably amend the claim petition in the Reference proceedings by challenging non- grant of compensation in respect of all the trees covered under the JMC report is accepted.

10. Under the circumstances, since the petitioner has already preferred Reference, before the Reference Court seeking re-determination/enhancement of compensation in respect of the lands, I deem it just and proper to dispose of this petition by setting aside the impugned endorsement at Annexure-F dated 25.03.2022, and reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to put forth and agitate all the claims / contentions as regards lands as well as non- grant of compensation in relation to all the trees covered under the JMC report before the Reference Court, before whom the Reference filed by the petitioner is pending adjudication.

In the result I pass the following:
ORDER i. Writ petition is disposed of.
ii. Impugned endorsement dated 25.03.2022 vide Annexure-F, issued by respondent No.3 is set aside, iii. Liberty is reserved in favour of the petitioner to suitably amend the claim petition before the Reference Court, so as to include the challenge to non-grant of compensation in respect of the trees covered under the JMC report dated 05.10.2012.

iv. The Reference Court is directed to consider the claim of the petitioner for enhancement of compensation in respect of the lands as well as all the trees covered under the JMC report in accordance with law and pass appropriate award/order determining compensation for the lands and all trees covered under the JMC report dated 05.10.2012.
